parts.official_mark_scheme_text: M1*: Substitute $z=x+iy$ and obtain an equation free of uncancelled $xy$ products, or obtain a horizontal equation in $z$. M1: Use $i^2=-1$ anywhere. A1: Obtain an equivalent expression free of products of complex numbers, or $z=(9+7i)/(1+3i)$. DM1: Equate real/imaginary parts and solve, or multiply numerator and denominator by $1-3i$ with numerator/denominator working shown. A1: $z=3-2i$ only. Printed special-case guidance applies to incomplete conjugate working. Total 5.
